decisions.question: Make path-scoped CI jobs? (asked as one of four cuts in a single multi-select question)

options.label: Yes
options.summary: Split spec-lint into areas (delivery, artifacts, specs, auth) that run only when their files change; an artifacts change takes ~4 min instead of 17; shared files still run everything.

options.label: No
options.summary: Keep one job that runs every suite for every change.

decisions.owner_words: Path-scoped CI jobs, Skip the main re-run, Agents test only what they touch, Audit the suites for duplicates

decisions.question: Skip the main re-run when its files equal what the ready PR tested? (same multi-select question)

options.label: Yes
options.summary: After a merge, skip CI on main when its files are identical to what the ready PR tested; also a STACKSPEC rule for every project.

options.label: No
options.summary: Keep the full run on main after every merge.

decisions.owner_words: Path-scoped CI jobs, Skip the main re-run, Agents test only what they touch, Audit the suites for duplicates

decisions.question: Agents test only what they touch? (same multi-select question)

options.label: Yes
options.summary: Agents run locally only the suites for files they changed, no branch CI run unless the change is Linux-specific; the ready PR stays the one full run.

options.label: No
options.summary: Agents keep running full suites locally and on their branches.

decisions.owner_words: Path-scoped CI jobs, Skip the main re-run, Agents test only what they touch, Audit the suites for duplicates

decisions.question: Audit the suites for duplicates? (same multi-select question)

options.label: Yes
options.summary: A Sonnet agent lists overlapping tests and proposes what to remove; nothing deleted without the owner's OK.

options.label: No
options.summary: No audit.

decisions.owner_words: Path-scoped CI jobs, Skip the main re-run, Agents test only what they touch, Audit the suites for duplicates

decisions.question: AR35 and AR37 are being tested now. Cut their testing short?

options.label: One CI run only
options.summary: Finish the local runs already going, skip branch CI runs, join, and let the ready PR's CI be the only check before merge.

options.label: Keep the current flow
options.summary: Run everything as today.

decisions.question: When should the mutation passes run?

options.label: When their files change, plus nightly
options.summary: S2: on a PR only when the mutated scripts or their test change; every mutant on main once a night. Saves 8.8 min on most PRs.

options.label: Nightly only
options.summary: Never on a PR; a weak test is found the next morning instead of before the merge.

options.label: Every PR, as today
options.summary: 8.8 min on every ready PR whatever changed.

decisions.chosen: When their files change, plus nightly

decisions.question: Retire the artifacts suite's fake-renderer group?

options.label: Retire it
options.summary: S6: drop the group, move its one unique case (test_check_runs_check_html) into the real group. Saves 46% of the suite.

options.label: Run it nightly only
options.summary: Keep the stand-in for a nightly run; PRs run the real group alone.

options.label: Keep both groups
options.summary: Every run keeps testing every case twice.

decisions.question: How often should the record push to main?

options.label: Once per turn
options.summary: S8: commit on every change, push at the end of the turn and before any PR, merge or publish. About 250 fewer pushes and scans a day.

options.label: On every change, as today
options.summary: Every status change is pushed and scanned at once; main keeps moving under CI.

decisions.question: When does the nightly full run with mutants start?

options.label: 03:00 UTC
options.summary: 04:00 Lisbon, while the owner sleeps.

options.label: Another time
options.summary: Owner names it.

decisions.question: Shorten the PR CI run (11 min, one serial delivery job with every suite's mutants on for any delivery change)?

options.label: 1+2, next small release
options.summary: Mutants per suite and the delivery suites as parallel jobs, as their own release after DL12; a change like DL12 goes from ~11 to ~2 min.
Also shard the gate mutation pass into parallel jobs (~7.8 to ~2.5 min when the gate scripts change).

options.label: Add to DL12 now
options.summary: Fold 1+2 into the running DL12 release so DL12 itself gets the faster CI.

options.label: Leave as is
options.summary: Keep the 11 min run.
